newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU 14 oil stocks down 5.27 mln barrels in August.
newsitem.headline: EU 14 oil stocks down 5.27 mln barrels in August.

text.p: Crude and oil product stocks in the European Union, excluding Sweden, fell by 5.27 million barrels, or 0.5 percent, in August to 1.007 million barrels, Stitchting Euroilstock said in its latest monthly report.
The inventories were also 4.7 percent, or 49.81 million barrels, lower than at the end of August 1995.
However, while stocks of crude and gasoline fell, those of middle distillates and fuel oil rose.

Crude stocks fell 9.13 million barrels, or 2.2 percent, at 401.79 million barrels at the end of August. Regionally, the greatest drop was of 5.11 million barrels in the Netherlands, followed by 2.92 million in France.
Gasoline inventories were down 3.66 million barrels, or 2.3 percent, at 153.51 million barrels. The fall was largest in France, at 2.13 million barrels.
Middle distillate stocks rose 3.75 million barrels, or 1.3 percent, to 286.28 million. Italy registered the greatest rise, of 3.38 million barrels, but German stocks fell by 2.63 million.
Fuel oil inventores were up 3.77 million barrels, or 2.8 percent, at 140.79 million barrels.
Naphtha stocks were steady at 24.64 million barrels.
Crude intake was 130,000 barrels per day (bpd) lower than in July at 11.094 million bpd, leading to a utilisation rate of 88.05 percent in August against 89.10 percent in July.
